```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
rd <- read_csv("raw.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
set.seed(2021)
td <- rd %>% 
  transmute(
    gender = recode(male, `0` = "female", `1` = "male"),
    minority = recode(minority, `0` = "no", `1` = "yes"),
    deprived_area = recode(deprived, `0` = "no", `1` = "yes"),
    mental_wellbeing = mwb,
    watch_wd,
    watch_we,
    play_wd,
    play_we,
    compute_wd = comp_wd,
    compute_we = comp_we,
    phone_wd = sp_wd,
    phone_we = sp_we
  ) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  sample_n(size = 3000, replace = FALSE) %>% 
  print()
write_csv(td, "../screentime.csv")
```
